To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the quality of the application, the utility of the application, enjoyment, and the perceived price are the most important factors that influence the satisfaction of the users and that satisfaction of the users is the most important factor that influences the brand equity.
mobile applications should be easy to use, provide the users with the information that they want, be fast, have good quality, be aesthetically pleasing, and not have a high perceived price.

users' satisfaction is affected positively by the utilitarian and hedonic benefits of the application, privacy risk and technicality of the application have a negative effect on satisfaction, and the perceived price of the application has no significant effect on satisfaction.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between the mobile application users and the mobile application providers. It is aimed to provide the mobile application providers
the factors affecting satisfaction and brand equity.
the relationship between the features of mobile applications and the users' satisfaction and the brand value of the applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the application quality has the most significant effect on users' satisfaction and brand equity.
the more users are satisfied with the mobile application they are using, the more they will be loyal to the brand and the more they will perceive the brand value.

, the more the application quality, application utility, enjoyment, privacy risk, and perceived price are, the more the satisfaction is, and the more the satisfaction, the more the brand value perception.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
mobile application developers should focus on application utility and application quality to increase the brand equity perception of users.
the application quality, application utility and enjoyment are the most important factors that affect users' satisfaction and brand equity perception.
the mobile applications should be developed with high utility and quality, and the privacy risks should be minimized to increase the satisfaction and brand equity perceptions of the users.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the application quality is the most important factor in terms of user satisfaction.

, in order to satisfy the mobile application users and increase the brand equity perception, it is important to provide a high-quality and functional application, to make the users enjoy the application and to make them feel safe in terms of their privacy.
the mobile phone application features that are related to the quality, utility, and enjoyment are important for users' satisfaction.
